title: person
description: An author and/or narrator. Authors and narrators are the same entity type; a person can be both.

kind.description: What sort of entity this record names. ABSENCE MEANS "person" - the field exists to mark the records that are not one: a group credited as a unit (a full cast, a band), a corporate credit of record (a publisher's in-house imprint), or a synthetic voice - a text-to-speech production rather than an individual. No importer infers the first three; a record carries one when a maintainer batch or a correction classified it, so an absent value is 'unclassified or an individual', never a guess. "synthetic" is the one exception: the importer writes it on the single canonical record every AI-narration credit folds onto.

librivox_reader_id.description: This person's LibriVox reader id. A LibriVox import keys readers on it, so a rerun (or a reader renamed on LibriVox) never mints a second record. Unique across the dataset (pkg/check). A reader whose name another reader id already holds has the id <name slug>-librivox-<this id>, which pkg/check accepts only on the record carrying this id.

librivox_reader_aliases.description: Further LibriVox reader ids this person answers to, for the person LibriVox lists under more than one reader record. The rules are librivox_author_aliases', in the reader namespace; librivox_reader_id stays the record's own.

librivox_author_id.description: This person's LibriVox author id (a separate namespace from reader ids). Unique across the dataset (pkg/check).

librivox_author_aliases.description: Further LibriVox author ids this person answers to, for the person LibriVox lists under more than one author record. A LibriVox import resolves each to this record, so the second id never mints a twin. Written only by a decision with evidence, never by an importer (no import records a second id on a person). Sorted ascending; each is unique against every librivox_author_id and every other alias across the dataset (pkg/check). It REQUIRES librivox_author_id (see dependentRequired): an alias is a further id, and librivox_author_id stays the record's own, the one its slug and the LibriVox-shaped feed state.

birth_year.description: The year this person was born, as a source stated it (LibriVox: an author's dob). Negative for a year BC; a value the source states but that is not a year ("alive", "c. 1500") is never written.

death_year.description: The year this person died, as a source stated it (LibriVox: an author's dod). Negative for a year BC; never before birth_year (pkg/check).
